understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn you choose MOVE_LEFT or MOVE_RIGHT (horizontal movement only); after the horizontal move, gravity (here: DOWN) automatically carries the character until landing on a solid/support tile, reaching the goal, or hitting a hazard. CLICK targets a specific [x,y] tile to interact with/remove clickable breakable blocks ('x') to open or alter fall paths; clicking does not move the player. Landing on spike tiles ('u'/'v') ends the attempt immediately. UNDO reverses the previous action to recover from a bad move/click.
